_lane: sim-rgbd-arm-collision-aware-v1 (PR-B: perceived-clearance gate + phase-shared mast feed)
_what: Make every arm leg collision-aware against the RGB-D nvblox ESDF. A perceived-clearance gate
wraps the motion port (gated_motion.GatedMotionPort, installed in ros_host.py) and, before the
controller dispatches ANY leg (pick approach, lift, tuck, pre-place, place descent, withdraw,
every transfer leg -- including the collision-OFF straight-line KDL inserts cuMotion does not
check), queries the live get_esdf_and_gradient map for the swept gripper + welded-carton volume
and refuses/holds by name when the clearance is below a margin (PERCEIVED_CLEARANCE lines).
Opt-in behind the HOST key perception_collision_gate; absent/disabled => the raw port, byte-
identical (the complete-cycle video run carries NO new perception).

perception_collision_gate._phases_default: approach, contact, lift, tuck, pan, transit, preplace, place, retreat
perception_collision_gate._mode: warn = log only; hold/refuse = raise PERCEIVED_CLEARANCE_<ACTION>, controller fails the phase by name, mission StageRetry re-begins against a fresher map
perception_collision_gate._set-down_note: the rollwagen is OUTSIDE the ESDF (handled by the cart world obstacle, PR-A). If the place/retreat legs read 'unobserved', either exclude them from `phases` or set unknown_action=warn -- the cart is collision-checked by the world obstacle, not the perceived ESDF.

world_obstacles_perceived._note: evidence-gated retirement (deliverable #4): list the static world_obstacle ids the perceived ESDF demonstrably covers (a camera-mapped body) to withhold their static CollisionObject. NOT for the cart (the ESDF cannot see it). Default [] => every static obstacle published (byte-identical).

masked_depth._role: wrist camera_0, always live during arm phases

mast_depth._role: camera_1, phase-shared ON for collect/carry/set-down ONLY -- keep OFF for live_pose transfer (does not fit the transfer VRAM peak)

feeds_per_phase._source: twin.restock.arm_feed_schedule.feeds_active_in_phase; the Isaac render-lifecycle (native_cameras.set_render_products_enabled / destroy_camera_render_product) consumes it

vram.collect/carry/set-down: wrist + mast fits: gpu_budget.check_collect_budget -> fits=True, ~1.0 GB free_after (collect base 8048 MiB; measured coldwin60-62 ~2.9 GB free, one wrist feed)
vram.live_pose transfer: wrist ONLY (transfer2 peak 11882 / 26 MiB free); mast does NOT fit (check_budget -> fits=False). gpu_budget refuses a mast-on transfer config pre-boot.
vram.gate: the perceived-clearance gate adds no VRAM (it queries the existing ESDF the planner already builds)

acceptance_stages.S0: cart world obstacle (PR-A): set-down plans around the cart with no CAGE filter, no straight-line insert
acceptance_stages.S1: mast-live carry: the ESDF keeps integrating (collision_time advances) with the carton held
acceptance_stages.S2: ESDF gate on inserts: a straight-line insert whose waypoints violate the live ESDF is refused by name (PERCEIVED_CLEARANCE_REFUSE) before motion
acceptance_stages.S3: perceived collect (tomorrow): arm routes around a perceived cage post, no ground truth -- only after S0+S1+S2
acceptance_stages._constraints: box parallel to ground 2.0 deg / 0.15 s grace never loosened; nothing visually wrong on camera; gpu_budget fits=True; lock only when free; never --force

hook_points_for_sibling_lanes.collision_gate.PerceptionCollisionGate.e: per-leg verdict (GateVerdict.min_clearance / action / nearest_body) -- the bench (sim-arm-collision-bench-v1) scores collision-free rate, minimum clearance and refusals from it
hook_points_for_sibling_lanes.collision_gate.swept_corridor_aabbs / Ga: the swept gripper+carton AABB corridor for a leg -- the reactive-replan lane (sim-arm-reactive-replan-v1) watches it for a NEW obstacle entering between dispatch and completion; the bench plants against it
hook_points_for_sibling_lanes.esdf_source.EsdfSource (NvbloxEsdfSource: the snapshot provider seam -- the bench swaps in a scripted static+moving-obstacle field (AnalyticBoxEsdfSource takes a boxes(now) callable = the dynamic-layer seam); the dynamic nvblox mapper feeds the same NvbloxEsdfSource
hook_points_for_sibling_lanes.gated_motion.GatedMotionPort: the motion-port wrapper -- the reactive lane subscribes a preempt/re-plan hook; execution-time preempt is THAT lane, this gate gates at dispatch
hook_points_for_sibling_lanes.tools/replay_collect_gate.replay_gate(le: CPU per-leg verdict replay over any leg list + any EsdfSource
